p_ia1: Designed preprocessing and clustering pipelines (K-Means, HAC, DBSCAN) using BoW, TF-IDF, Skip-gram, SBERT, and traced silhouette <0.30 to repeated template vocabulary in tickets.
p_ql1: Fine-tuned QLoRA Llama 3.1 8B (4-bit, Unsloth, TRL) on a 15 GB GPU, training 0.52% of parameters, raising answer completion from 32% to 52% and exact-answer accuracy from 16.2% to 27.3% on 99 NuminaMath problems.
p_ql3: Reported that accuracy on completed answers barely improved (50% vs 52%) and traced out-of-memory errors to multiple models loaded in one runtime, not the KV cache.
